# Protacc

> Protacc is a Chartered Accountant (CA) firm based in Kaithal, Haryana, offering online GST, income tax, company registration and compliance services to individuals and businesses across India.

## Services

- [All services](https://protacc.in/services): GST, income tax, company registration, licenses and compliance
- [GST Registration](https://protacc.in/services/gst-registration): Online GST registration with GSTIN, documents and process
- [ITR Filing (Salary + one house property)](https://protacc.in/services/salary-one-house-property-itr-filing): Income tax return filing for salaried individuals
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://protacc.in/services/private-limited-company-registration): Company incorporation across India
- [Trademark Registration](https://protacc.in/services/trademark-registration): Brand name and logo trademark filing

## Resources

- [Articles](https://protacc.in/articles): Guides and updates on GST, income tax and compliance
- [Consultancy](https://protacc.in/consultancy): Book a free consultation with a Chartered Accountant
